title: Kissed Lazy Moroccan Vine Leaves Bissara
description: A lazy Sunday Moroccan dish featuring vine leaves with a grassy and cheese-pull taste, made with shio-cure and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients in a bissara form.
instructions: Rinse the vine leaves and remove the stems.
In a large bowl, mix together shio-cure, feta cheese, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the vine leaves to the bowl and toss to coat with the shio-cure mixture.
Let it sit for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the vine leaves with the shio-cure mixture.
Cook for 10-15 minutes or until the vine leaves are tender and the mixture is heated through.
Serve the bissara hot, garnished with additional feta cheese and lemon wedges if desired.
Let it cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
